svg.title: Global user instructions and project context files
svg.desc: A folder at ~/.claude/ holds global user instructions. CLAUDE.md contains example paths to WRITING.md, CODING.md, MODELING.md, and CONVENTIONS.md, with instructions on when to read them. Separate paper folders at papers/paper-a/ and papers/paper-b/ keep their own instructions, status, tasks, current specification, and decision log in project context files. The website keeps CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, TASKS.md, and DESIGN.md inside websites/group-site/. The three project paths are relative to the workspace.
